author: coordinator
purpose: The complete enumeration of device cells that the six probe documents assign to P09, each mapped to the record field that observes it, or to the amendment that defers it by name, or marked not observable with the reason. A documented cell missing from this list is a defect in this file to be fixed by adding the cell, not a reason to reject P09 for omission. Records cited: 2026-10-09-device-matrix.json (rev 4) and 2026-10-10-latency-accessibility.json.

cells.item: whether delivered notifications or repeating triggers count against the pending limit
